import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod1 = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000007;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n, cnt1, cnt2, ans;
    static long[] sum = new long[10];
    static long[] Pow = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int readInt(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        int sign = 1;
        int num = 0;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) return -1;
            if (Character.isDigit(ch) || ch == '-') break;
        }
        if (ch == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            ch = br.read();
        }
        while (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            num = num * 10 + (ch - '0');
            ch = br.read();
        }
        return sign * num;
    }

    static void writeLong(BufferedWriter bw, long x) throws IOException {
        if (x < 0) {
            bw.write('-');
            writeLong(bw, -x);
            return;
        }
        if (x >= 10) {
            writeLong(bw, x / 10);
        }
        bw.write((char) (x % 10 + '0'));
    }

    static void writeln(BufferedWriter bw, long x) throws IOException {
        writeLong(bw, x);
        bw.write('\n');
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        long now = 1000000L;
        return x * now + 999999L <= n && x * now * 10 > n;
    }

    static void dfs1(int x1, long x2) {
        if (x1 == 7) return;
        long valToAdd = ((cnt1 - x2) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
        val[x1].add(valToAdd);
        sum[x1] += valToAdd;
        cnt1++;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int x1, long x2) {
        if (x2 > n) return;
        if (check(x2)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long now = ((cnt2 + 1 - (x2 * Pow[i]) % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;
                int pos = lowerBound(val[i], (long) (mod1 - now));
                ans = (ans + (sum[i] + now * val[i].size() - (long) val[i].size() * mod1 + mod2) % mod2) % mod2;
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
        } else {
            cnt2++;
            long temp = ((cnt2 - x2) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
            ans = (ans + temp) % mod2;
            for (int i = (!x1) ? 0 : 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                dfs2(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        BufferedWriter bw = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        cnt1 = 0;
        cnt2 = -1;
        ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            val[i].clear();
            sum[i] = 0;
        }
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        dfs2(0, 0);
        writeln(bw, ans);
        bw.flush();
    }
}
